title: Fix Rerun camera frustum and image colors
objective: Update examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py so Rerun shows the live camera in world frame with a correct visible frustum/image plane/projection, and so RGB/depth/normals/diffuse image streams have clear paths and color handling.
instructions: Implement the Scout recommendations from the seeded ResultPacket.
Keep Rerun root as a right-handed Z-up world and convert Unreal/SPEAR camera positions/vectors to that world before logging.
Log camera pose and pinhole at spear/camera with explicit camera_xyz=rr.ViewCoordinates.RDF, visible frustum styling, and image_plane_distance so the RGB projection appears in 3D.

Move all camera-captured image streams that should attach to the pinhole under spear/camera/..., including depth_meters. Keep names explicit for world_normal_visualization and diffuse_color or diffuse_color_visualization.
Make color conversion explicit: final tone curve RGB should display naturally, diffuse_color should be gamma corrected for visualization, normals should be clearly false-color normal visualization.
Update terminal/status logging only if needed to keep world-frame camera position and light vectors coherent.
Update README only if user-visible paths or behavior changed enough to keep it accurate.
constraints: Do not change unrelated examples or core SPEAR APIs.
Do not run live simulator-dependent commands; use static/stub validation where practical.
expected_outputs: Patched script and any necessary README text.
definition_of_done: A lightweight Rerun API/stub smoke test passes or any limitation is reported.
ResultPacket explains the coordinate conversion, Rerun entity paths, and color handling changes.
